caption: The drawing features a large, prominent outline of a horse rendered in blue on a beige background with a rectangular, textured patch behind the horse. The horse is shown in profile, facing left, with its head lowered, mane and tail drawn in sweeping, curved lines, and its legs slightly bent in different positions, suggesting movement. In the upper right corner of the image, there is an outline of a tall vessel, also drawn in blue. The vessel is shaped like a jug with a narrow neck, a curved handle, and a rounded body. Inside the outline of the vessel, there is a smaller depiction of a horse, also drawn in blue lines, mimicking the larger horse's pose. There is a signature in gray pencil at the bottom left of the image. The overall composition uses blue and beige primarily and emphasizes line drawing with minimal shading or color variation.
title: Jug
